title: The Endless Stairs and the Race — Part 5

series.summary: The applicants encounter a massive, punishing staircase leading out of the tunnel. Gon and Killua wager a dinner bet and race up hundreds of stairs at breakneck speed, bursting across the finish line into the sunlight simultaneously.

segments.voiceover_text: The flat tunnel ends, revealing a monstrous staircase climbing into the dark. Satotz accelerates, and exhausted applicants collapse in agony on the punishing stone steps.
Gon and Killua surge to the front of the pack. Killua dares Gon to a race to the summit, betting that the loser must buy dinner.
The two twelve-year-olds sprint up the brutal stairs side by side at breakneck speed, leaving the gasping crowd far behind as daylight appears overhead.
They burst into the sunlight at the exact same instant. They laugh and bicker over who won, while the massive stone door slams shut behind them.
